# PEDatamine research snapshot

Unmodified `_Cleaned_Final_Data_6_2_2020.csv` downloaded from
<https://github.com/nschauser/PolymerElectrolyte>. The repository declares an
MIT license. SHA-256:
`c85f0568e8bde46913c009935ce0bf0643a72b9f086f5cc5d21ac724412baa63`.

The table is a secondary literature compilation. Repository licensing does not
replace attribution to the 65 source articles, so every derived row retains DOI
and reference fields. It is read as Latin-1 because the released CSV is not
valid UTF-8. Do not redistribute a transformed version without retaining this
provenance and reviewing source-article terms.
